observed.caption: Two people rest on a grassy hilltop overlooking a wide valley with wind turbines and a communications tower on a distant ridge.
observed.description: In the foreground, a broad grassy hilltop with patches of green and brown grass fills the lower two-thirds of the image. In the bottom-left corner, two people in plaid shirts are on the grass, one sitting upright and one reclining with their head near the other person. Scattered low trees and shrubs dot the mid-distance hills. On a ridge to the left, several tall white wind turbines and a lattice telecommunications tower are visible. Thin black overhead power lines cross the upper portion of the image horizontally and diagonally. Beyond the hills, a hazy, sprawling valley settlement extends to the horizon under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds.
